# 云依助手 / CloudYi Assistant

> A local-first browser toolbox migrated from CloudYiCSC and maintained alongside the CloudYi Assistant Windows client.

Site: https://faw.cloudyic.com/
Repository: https://github.com/CloudYiC/DesktopPet

## Browser tools

- C/WebAssembly: MD5, SHA-256, Base64, Hex, URL encoding, UUID, password, timestamp, number formatting
- TypeScript: JSON formatting, JWT inspection, regular expressions, text diff
- Tool input stays in the browser and is not uploaded for computation.

## Desktop-only capabilities

The Windows client adds the animated desktop character, scheduled reminders, SQLite data,
system tray integration, system information, port inspection, protected process actions,
and local plugin registration. Static web pages cannot access these Win32 capabilities.

## Deployment

Run `npm ci && npm run build` in `web/`, then deploy `web/out/` as a static site.
